global.title: NOAA High-resolution Blended Analysis: Daily Values using AVHRR only
global.dataset_title: NOAA Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature
global.comment: Reynolds, et al.(2007) Daily High-Resolution-Blended Analyses for Sea Surface Temperature (available at https://doi.org/10.1175/2007JCLI1824.1). Banzon, et al.(2016) A long-term record of blended satellite and in situ sea-surface temperature for climate monitoring, modeling and environmental studies (available at https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-8-165-2016). Huang, B., C. Liu, V. Banzon, E. Freeman, G. Graham, B. Hankins, T. Smith, and H.-M. Zhang, 2021: Improvements of the Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (DOISST) Version 2.1 (available at https://doi.org/10.1175/JCLI-D-20-0166.1). Anomaly is based on 1971-2000 OI.v2 SST. Satellite data: multi-satellite sensor (AVHRR+VIIRS) data. Ice data: NCEP Ice and GSFC Ice. Data less than 15 days old may be subject to revision.
